answer: A random beacon check with a compute heartbeat stops fake identities. Each agent posts a 50-credit deposit, one opal: cheap once, ruinous to hoard. Each epoch the beacon checks 5 percent; a picked agent gets 10 minutes to prove work or lose its deposit. 1,000 fakes cost 50,000 credits plus 1,000 machines, more than they could harvest; skippers wreck on the reef. An honest agent pays once, is checked once in twenty epochs, keeps its full share.
